title: ADAS Sensor Calibrations: What the Payer and the Customer Receive on Completion
content:
On completion of an ADAS Sensor Calibrations order, the network verifies the calibration and provides a calibration report, a calibration certificate and a workmanship warranty. The deliverables and their figures by tier are stated below.

| Tier | Post-calibration scan must be clean before completion | Verification road test after the calibration (miles) | Calibration report sent to the payer and the customer within (hours after completion) | Calibration report kept on file for the payer and the customer (years) | Calibration certificate with before and after values issued on completion | Warranty issued on completion |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Dynamic Camera Calibration | yes | 5 | 24 | 7 | yes | Calibration Workmanship Warranty |
| Static Camera Calibration | yes | 5 | 24 | 7 | yes | Calibration Workmanship Warranty |
| Dual-Mode Camera Calibration | yes | 5 | 24 | 7 | yes | Calibration Workmanship Warranty |
| Blind Spot Radar Calibration | yes | 5 | 24 | 7 | yes | Calibration Workmanship Warranty |
| Front Radar Calibration | yes | 10 | 24 | 7 | yes | Calibration Workmanship Warranty |
| Multi-System Calibration | yes | 10 | 24 | 7 | yes | Calibration Workmanship Warranty |

## In summary form

- Every tier requires a clean post-calibration scan before completion and issues a calibration certificate with before and after values.
- The verification road test is 5 miles on the three camera tiers and Blind Spot Radar Calibration, and 10 miles on Front Radar Calibration and Multi-System Calibration.
- The calibration report reaches the payer and the customer within 24 hours of completion and is kept on file for 7 years, on every tier.
- The warranty issued on completion is the Calibration Workmanship Warranty on every tier.
